description: Find releasable FAA remote pilot certificate records by Unique ID or name. While the operator's personal-data redaction is on (the default), name mode needs lastName and firstName, nameMatch prefix and city or ZIP filters are rejected, and city and ZIP are withheld. Results establish certificate presence in the local snapshot; they do not establish recurrent-training currency, commercial operating authority, or current Part 107 eligibility.

city.description: Exact city, 1–60 visible characters; requires operator-enabled location access and is rejected while personal-data redaction is on. Blank means unset.

firstName.description: FIRST NAME, which usually includes middle names; the default words match finds JOHN ROBERT from JOHN. 1–60 visible characters after normalization. Blank means unset.

lastName.description: LAST NAME, which may include a suffix; the default words match finds SMITH JR from SMITH. 1–60 visible characters after normalization. Blank means unset.

limit.description: Maximum complete people or reference entries per page; default 10, maximum 50. A larger limit returns at most 50, with a notice.

mode.description: id requires uniqueId and forbids nonblank name/location fields and explicit nameMatch; name requires lastName, plus firstName while personal-data redaction is on, and forbids nonblank uniqueId.

nameMatch.description: How each supplied name field matches; default words for name searches. words: the field equals the term or continues with a space after it; only a space separates words, so a hyphenated or apostrophe name is one word. exact: the whole field. prefix: the field begins with the term, also mid-word; rejected while personal-data redaction is on.

offset.description: Zero-based offset; default 0, maximum 10000. Follow nextOffset or narrow filters at the cap.

state.description: Two-letter state or territory; trimmed and uppercased. Blank means unset.

uniqueId.description: Opaque FAA Unique ID returned by faa_airmen_verify_certificate in name mode, A or C plus seven digits, for example A9999999; not a certificate number. Trimmed and uppercased.

zipCode.description: Five-digit ZIP or ZIP+4, preserving leading zeros; requires operator-enabled location access and is rejected while personal-data redaction is on. Blank means unset.

appliedFilters.description: Every effective normalized selector, filter, and paging value.

atPagingCap.description: Matches remain but the next offset exceeds 10000; narrow the filters.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_identity`: Invalid or blank semantic identity selector. `invalid_filter`: Invalid code, location, or filter combination after normalization. `location_access_disabled`: Nonblank city or ZIP filter supplied while location access is disabled. `pii_redacted`: Personal-data redaction is on and the call sends city or ZIP, a name search without both names, or nameMatch prefix. `mirror_missing`: No complete published mirror generation is available. `mirror_unavailable`: Published generation is corrupt, missing, incompatible, or unreadable. `mirror_rebuild_required`: Location access is enabled but this generation discarded city and ZIP. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.
